description: 5 terrain types covering the 64×64 tile map. Each tile is 32×32px. WATER is impassable; TREE is walkable and a resource node; GOLD is a resource node.
schema:
TERRAIN = { GRASS:0, DIRT:1, WATER:2, TREE:3, GOLD:4 }
map.tiles: Terrain[][] (64×64)
Colors (game / minimap):
  GRASS #4a8c2a / #3a7a20
  DIRT  #b8a060 / #a89050
  WATER #3060a0 / #2050a0
  TREE  #2a5a18 / #1a4a10
  GOLD  #8a7a30 / #c8a020

description: 4 unit types, keyed by string. Units are flat JS objects created by createUnit(). Shared fields: id, type, owner, x, y, w, h, hp, maxHp, state, speed, attackDamage, attackRange, attackCooldown, attackTimer, targetId, moveTarget, path, isBuilding=false, faceDir, canGather, canBuild, food, size, ranged, carryAmount, carryType, gatheringNode, gatheringTimer, buildTarget.
schema:
peasant: cost={gold:50}, hp=40, speed=140, atk=5, range=24, food=1, size=16, canGather=true, canBuild=true
footman: cost={gold:100,wood:30}, hp=60, speed=120, atk=10, range=24, food=2, size=18, melee
archer:  cost={gold:120,wood:40}, hp=45, speed=120, atk=8, range=140, food=2, size=16, ranged
knight:  cost={gold:150,wood:60}, hp=80, speed=200, atk=12, range=24, food=2, size=22, fast cavalry

description: 7 building types, keyed by string. Buildings are flat JS objects created by createBuilding(). Extends entity shared fields plus: progress (0-1), produces[], queue[], queueTimer, queueTotal, rallyPoint, dropoff flags (dropoff, dropoff_gold, dropoff_wood), provides[], blocking.
schema:
town_hall:   cost={gold:200,wood:100}, size=96×96, hp=800, buildTime=10s, trains=peasant, dropoff=gold+wood, provides=food+5
barracks:    cost={gold:150,wood:50},  size=80×80, hp=500, buildTime=6s,  trains=footman+archer
stable:      cost={gold:100,wood:100}, size=80×80, hp=400, buildTime=6s,  trains=knight
lumber_mill: cost={gold:100,wood:50},  size=64×64, hp=350, buildTime=5s,  dropoff=wood
refinery:    cost={gold:100,wood:50},  size=64×64, hp=350, buildTime=5s,  dropoff=gold
watch_tower: cost={gold:50,wood:50},   size=48×48, hp=300, buildTime=4s,  auto-attack (cosmetic only)
wall:        cost={gold:20,wood:10},   size=32×32, hp=200, buildTime=2s,  blocking barrier

description: Single global state object (const game = {...}) holding all mutable game state.
schema:
entities: Map<string, Entity>               — all units + buildings
resources: { gold:200, wood:150, food:3, maxFood:5, resourcesEarned:{gold:0,wood:0} }
selectedIds: Set<string>                       — currently selected entity IDs
map: { tiles: Terrain[][] }                    — 64×64 tile grid
camera: { x, y, targetX, targetY, zoom }      — viewport state
ui: { mode, buildingType, attackMode }         — UI mode (default/build/attack)
mouse: { sx, sy, worldX, worldY, button, drag, currentTarget }
selectionBox: { x1,y1,x2,y2 } | null          — rubber-band selection rect
ghostBuilding: Building | null                 — placement preview
particles: Particle[]                          — visual particle effects
floatingTexts: FloatingText[]                  — damage/heal floating numbers
autoBuildCooldown: {}                          — prevents duplicate auto-build per resource type
nextId: 0, time: 0

description: Entities use a state-machine pattern via the 'state' string field.
schema:
idle        — standing by
moving      — pathing toward moveTarget
attacking   — engaged with targetId (pursuit + cooldown)
gathering   — moving to/from resource node
building    — peasant constructing a building
constructing — building being built (progress < 1)
walking     — legacy/fallback
State transitions driven by updateEntity() per-frame logic.

description: Simple attack system: units select nearest enemy in range, pursue, and attack on cooldown.
schema:
attackDamage: number (5-12)
attackRange: number in px (24 melee / 140 archer)
attackCooldown: 1.0s (global)
attackTimer: counts down, when ≤ 0 unit can attack again
targetId: string | null — current enemy target
attackTarget: {x,y} | null — attack-move destination
Attack-move mode (A key): auto-engage enemies along path
No armor, no damage types, no splash, no friendly fire

description: Resource flow: gather → carry → return → deposit.
schema:
Resources: gold (mined from GOLD tiles), wood (chopped from TREE tiles)
carryAmount: 10 per trip (hardcoded)
carryType: 'gold' | 'wood' | null
Gathering cycle: move to resource → gatherTimer (~1s animation) → set carry → move to dropoff → deposit → loop
Auto-build dropoff: if no dropof building exists when a peasant returns with resources, the game auto-builds a refinery (gold) or lumber_mill (wood) at a valid nearby site, deducts cost, assigns the peasant to construct it, and retries on failure every ~2s.
